claims: this is the first full year the marginal repayment system and the FY2026-27 threshold settings interact with an assessment, after 2.8% indexation was applied on 1 June 2026
whys: Tax time 2026 assesses 2025-26 income, so the 2025-26 HELP repayment thresholds apply, not FY2026-27 settings. The marginal repayment system started 1 July 2025, so this is the first year it is assessed at all, not the 'first full year'. Please also confirm the 2.8% 1 June 2026 indexation figure.
constants: HELP repayment threshold and indexation constants (lib/constants or HECS data file used by /news/hecs-indexation-2026/)
reviewerNotes: The writer's fact questions are confirmed as worth asking. HECS: tax time 2026 assesses 2025-26 income under the 2025-26 thresholds, not 'FY2026-27 threshold settings'. 2025-26 is the first year of the marginal system, not the 'first full year'. The 2.8% figure for 1 June 2026 is unconfirmed. Gift $2 minimum removal: no known enacted change matches it. TBC: the general cap is indexed to CPI, not 'average balances'. TBC: 'links directly' to the concessional and non-concessional caps overstates the link. TBC: the 13 July 2026 display date is in stale future tense. I left all of them unchanged, as the brief requires.
